summary: Becerra called for a Gaza ceasefire at the 2024 World Health Assembly and labeled the US-Israeli war in Iran illegal in a 2026 debate. Asked in May 2026 whether Israel's actions were genocide, he criticized Netanyahu and demanded international accountability without affirming the term. CAIR Action endorsed him in the general; Vote for Peace rated him Neutral. His documented positions condemn serious harm but stop short of demanding an end to US military aid, placing him in a moderate tier.
